title: deferred-tenant-shelve-and-regional-rejoin-smoother-hotpatch
author: Ava Thompson
description: Motivation: During a recent regional recovery incident we observed a spike of tenant rejoin traffic that amplified load and caused cascading KV cache thrashing. This PR implements a deferred "soft-shelve" (tenant shelving with scheduled rejoin) plus a regional rejoin smoother to prevent stampeding reattaches and stabilise SLO enforcement. Design summary: introduce tenant.shelve.* controls that mark low-priority tenants as shelved (requests return 429 with X-Redwood-Shelved header) but record a scheduled rejoin window; add a regional coordinator to stagger rejoin windows with jitter and exponential backoff windows per-tenant; add a light-weight soft-eviction path on the scheduler so shelved tenants stop consuming slot reservations but preserve KV sync state for fast restore. Changes also include metrics, tracing, and a canary rollout plan. Checklist: - [x] design doc updated and linked (ENG-4290) - [x] unit + integration tests for scheduler and API gating - [x] e2e chaos test simulating regional reconnect spikes - [x] telemetry dashboards for shelve/rejoin rates - [x] gradual rollout with feature flag and canary nodes Implementation notes: commits touch runtime/scheduler (soft_shelve manager, eviction hook), gateway/handlers (shelve response headers, admin API to force-shelve/unshelve), coordinator/service (regional-rejoin-smoother), telemetry (metrics: shelving.rate, rejoin.attempts, rejoin.success, rejoin.backoff_ms), config defaults (tenant.shelve.cooldown_ms=300000, tenant.shelve.max_retries=5, tenant.rejoin.jitter_pct=20), and docs/ops (runbook snippet). Backwards compatibility: shelved tenants are signalled via 429 and an opt-in header; no model interface changes. Rollout plan: enable feature behind ff:tenant_shelve_v2; schedule 10% of traffic on canary nodes for 48h, ramp to 50% over 24h, full rollout contingent on no increase in host CPU or KV eviction rates beyond 10% over baseline. Testing: local unit test coverage added; integration harness includes a synthetic reconnect storm test that shows mean request latency improvement for non-shelved tenants by ~22% under load. Observability: added dashboards and alerts: AlertShelvingSurge if shelving.rate > 100/min per region; AlertRejoinOscillation if rejoin.attempts > threshold. Security & RBAC: admin API gated behind operator role using existing RBAC. Related: addresses SUP-1187 incident and links to ENG-4312 follow-up for API-level retry guidance.
